text: This report recommends approving an award to Ontario Sewer Services Inc. for the provision of all labour, materials and equipment necessary for drain cleaning and flushing services as required for a one-year term with three one-year options to renew. This recommendation follows the competitive Request for Quotation process undertaken by Exhibition Place considering 6 companies that have previous experience providing these services.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved a contract with Ontario Sewer Services Inc. for drain cleaning and flushing services on the terms and conditions set out in the report (September 6, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer and City Solicitor.
